overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice named each license-renewal establishment and its license type, so omitting street addresses did not make the topic insufficiently specific. The AG only encouraged adding addresses.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the December 13 meeting notice for license renewals lacked sufficient detail because it omitted establishments' street addresses.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting addresses from the notice.
